name: Kakegurui
description: Run by a corrupt and sadistic school council, the “system” at Hyakkaou is based on gambling, with losers who cannot cover their debts being demeaned by their peers and forced to serve their debtholders. And if that’s not terrifying enough, some games can result in losing an eye, one’s fingernails, or even their life! But the system is shocked when transfer student Yumeko Jabami arrives. Dark, mysterious and attractive, she’s a wildcard who plays for the thrill of it…

videos.title: The Woman Called Yumeko Jabami
videos.overview: Reigning class gambling champion Mary attempts to hustle unsuspecting transfer student Yumeko Jabami into a high-stakes game of rock-paper-scissors.

videos.title: The Boring Woman
videos.overview: Mary is relegated to the lowest levels of the gambling hierarchy after her loss. Student board member Itsuki challenges Yumeko to a game of pairs.

videos.title: Slit-Eyed Woman
videos.overview: To regain her status, Mary duels student board member Yuriko in a game of "life or death." With Mary's crushing defeat, Yumeko offers to play next.

videos.title: The Woman Who Became Livestock
videos.overview: Yumeko and Mary square off against two others in a game of Indian poker after being given a chance to minimize their colossal gambling debts.

videos.title: The Woman Who Became Human
videos.overview: Kiwatari continues to lose as Yumeko and Mary bluff their way through the game, but the final outcome all comes down to Tsubomi.

videos.title: Tempting Woman
videos.overview: Yumeko must face Beautification Committee Chair Midari in an ESP card game involving Russian roulette before playing the student board president.

videos.title: Refusing Women
videos.overview: Deeply engaged in their deadly ESP card game, Midari tells Yumeko about her heated match against student board president, Kirari.

videos.title: Love-Dancing Woman
videos.overview: In Kirari's absence, pop idol sensation Yumemi offers to play against Yumeko, asking her to wager total control of her life.

videos.title: Dreaming Woman
videos.overview: With her pop idol career on the line, an enraged Yumemi seeks to ruin Yumeko after a scandalous voice recording is used as a bargaining chip.

videos.title: Selective Woman
videos.overview: Yumeko's odds are stacked against her when she challenges the well-funded student board treasurer, Manyuda, in an original game of poker.

videos.title: The Woman Who Bets Her Life
videos.overview: Itsuki, no longer wanting to be under Manyuda's control, offers to bankroll 100 chips after Yumeko goes all-in and loses on the previous hand.

videos.title: Gambling Woman
videos.overview: Yumeko and student board president Kirari both wager self-expulsion from the academy as Ryota becomes the key to the final outcome of their game.

videos.title: Compulsive Gambling Girls Redux
videos.overview: Erimi challenges Yumeko and Midari to a brutal game involving a sadistic finger-slicing contraption.

videos.title: The Momobami Clan Girls
videos.overview: The Momobami clan becomes upset when Kirari announces that the election winner will take over as leader of their family.

videos.title: The Untouchable Girl
videos.overview: With election committee chair Runa Yomotsuki presiding, former Vice President Ririka pits Miyo and Miri against Yumeko.

videos.title: The Connected Girls
videos.overview: Playing in Yumeko's place, Mary orders Ryota to show his cards; Miyo tries to convince Ryota to keep his cards to himself.

videos.title: The Changing Girl
videos.overview: To gain more chips, Yumemi ropes Yumeko into joining her; a Hollywood star's entry raises the stakes.

videos.title: The Hollywood Girl
videos.overview: Outwitted by Kawaru Natari during the first round, Yumemi goes all-in for the second round.

videos.title: The Traitorous Girl
videos.overview: With Kirari rapidly collecting votes, Yumeko and the other players gamble amongst themselves to boost their chip count, or lose it all.

videos.title: The Undefeatable Girl
videos.overview: Accused of treachery, Yumeko threatens to throw the game; to test Manyuda, Itsuki decides to take a major risk.

videos.title: The Adjacent Girl
videos.overview: With everything they each hold dear on the line, Sayaka challenges Yumeko to a game.

videos.title: The Logical Girl
videos.overview: Sayaka uses logic to advance; Yumeko's curiosity sways her to take an alternate route.

videos.title: The X Girl
videos.overview: A select group of contestants are invited to bid in an auction; Yumeko changes the rules by offering the unimaginable.

videos.title: The Zero Girl
videos.overview: A hostile Rei declares that she will win the election and take over, but Yumeko stands in her way.

language: Japanese, English, Portuguese, German, Spanish, Italian, Hungarian
